title: THRIFTY: Cost-Constrained Reasoning-Data Synthesis for Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for efficient, specialized deployment, and are typically trained on reasoning trajectories distilled from a larger teacher LLM. Generating this synthetic data is a major cost of the pipeline, especially when the teacher is a frontier model. Existing collection methods, however, are largely cost-unaware, or at best spread a fixed sampling budget uniformly across queries. Such allocation ignores the wide variation in problem difficulty and the strategic over- or under-sampling it invites. translated_title: THRIFTY：面向小语言模型的成本受限推理数据合成
translated_abstract: 小语言模型（SLM）因其在高效、专业化部署方面的吸引力与日俱增，通常在从更大的教师大语言模型（LLM）蒸馏得到的推理轨迹上进行训练。生成这类合成数据是该训练流程中的主要成本，尤其当教师模型是前沿模型时。然而，现有的数据收集方法大多不考虑成本，或者至多将固定的采样预算均匀分配到各个查询上。这种分配方式忽略了问题难度的巨大差异，以及由此引发的策略性过度采样或采样不足。因此，我们提出THRIFTY，一种基于Thompson采样的多臂老虎机控制器，它在固定的生成token预算内收集多样且正确的推理轨迹，将这一任务建模为带背包约束的多臂老虎机问题，并引入了新颖的多样性感知目标。该方法通过在线Beta后验跟踪每个问题的成功概率，并将每个token花费在预期产生最多新的、不同的正确解之处（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出THRIFTY——一种基于Thompson采样的带背包约束多臂老虎机控制器，在固定的生成token预算下自适应地将预算分配给不同难度的问题，从而低成本地为小语言模型合成多样且正确的推理训练数据。
en_tdlr: THRIFTY is a Thompson-sampling bandits-with-knapsacks controller that adaptively allocates a fixed generation-token budget across problems of varying difficulty to cost-effectively synthesize diverse, correct reasoning trajectories for small language models.
